name: – After § 4 – Am 19
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 4e. Reiterates its full support for the UN General Assembly resolutions on the need to end the economic, commercial and financial embargo imposed by the United States against Cuba; strongly supports the recent statements by the UN human rights expert group condemning the US executive order imposing a fuel blockade on Cuba and all unilateral, coercive and extraterritorial measures that aggravate the humanitarian crisis and are incompatible with international law; urges the United States to revise its designation of Cuba as a state sponsor of terrorism and end judicial weaponisation against Cuba, in line with the statement of the UN human rights experts group; reiterates that the EU does not recognise the US extraterritorial sanctions and considers that their effects are contrary to international law;
